data.value.spawnProjectiles.description: Spawn lines specifically for projectiles, used with "proj ref" value types
data.value.spawnProjectiles.note: If you need to use offsetDir to rotate your projectiles in a different direction (like for shrapnel), you must also set these projectile speeds low enough to force their trajectory
Chance this projectile will spawn. Defaults to 1.
data.value.spawnProjectiles.recursionLim: Prevents loops, useful with spawning itself so it doesn't infinitely spawn, good for chain exploding. (Recommended no more than 4 if spawning more than 3 projectiles)
data.value.spawnProjectiles.xOffsetRelat: Similar to offsetX, but the offset is relative to the position of the projectile
data.value.spawnProjectiles.yOffsetRelat: Similar to xOffsetRelative, but for Y axis
data.value.spawnProjectiles.offsetRandom: Random value to offset in the X axis only
Random value to offset in the Y axis only
The offset in both directions to randomly spawn, makes truly random spawning within an area
Sets random direction of the projectile
